game.name: Project Gotham Racing 4 (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru,Cs,Hu)
game.desc: Project Gotham Racing 4 is a racing game for Xbox 360. The fourth installment in the series, the title features over a hundred different vehicles, and now allows you to control two-wheelers. Several game modes allow you to try your hand at this racing simulation, which also features a split-screen multiplayer mode, multi-console link and Online.
